title: Visual AI Agent Event
description: Union of all event types produced by the Chrome extension and consumed by the backend.

eventId.description: UUID v4 generated by the extension at event creation time

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event fired

url.description: Full URL of the active tab at event time

behavioralEvent.description: Fired for nav, click, scroll, and idle signals — no AI processing, no screenshotRef.

meta.description: Event-specific metadata; only relevant fields are populated.

clickTarget.description: CSS selector or tag name of clicked element

scrollPct.description: Scroll depth as % of page height

idleSeconds.description: Seconds of idle before this event fired

screenshotEvent.description: Fired when a screenshot is taken. screenshotRef is populated by the backend after upload. AI fields are added by the vision worker after classification.

screenshotRef.description: Relative path returned by POST /api/screenshots/upload (e.g. data/screenshots/2026-07-30/uuid.jpg)

status.description: Processing state set by the vision worker

ai.description: Populated after Gemini classification; absent or null while status=pending.

app.description: Application or website name inferred from the screenshot

activitySummary.description: One-sentence description of what the user was doing

confidence.description: Model self-reported confidence; events below 0.6 are flagged for review
